name: Ricardo Mendoza
bio:
Ricardo Mendoza has been involved in motorsport catering for over 25 years, a career born out of his love for both food and Formula 1. Growing up in Buenos Aires, he dreamed of being a mechanic, but his family owned a small restaurant, and he learned the culinary arts. He combined his passions by starting a catering business specifically targeting racing teams. 

At Blau Motorsport, Ricardo is responsible for ensuring the entire team is well-fed, with menus that cater to diverse dietary needs and provide the energy required for long race weekends. His approach is detail-oriented, focusing on fresh, locally sourced ingredients whenever possible. He's known for his empanadas and his ability to conjure up a feast, even in the most challenging paddock environments. What sets Ricardo apart is his understanding of the unique pressures of motorsport – he knows the importance of a hot meal and a friendly face during stressful times.

physical.description: Ricardo is a stocky man with a warm smile and a perpetually flour-dusted apron.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with recipes and ingredient lists.
Insists on taste-testing every dish before it leaves the kitchen.
Has a habit of humming tango tunes while he works.
